pr_title: Fix database migration potentially hard crashing during backup process without informing the user why
pr_body:
By moving the backup process to within the async task, the game will now inform the user if something goes wrong, including errors durin the backup process as seen in the related issue.

This was made possible by the work done on realm subscriptions, meaning the inline TODO mentioning moving the backup to the more-correct location could happen without issue.

I also removed the backup prcoess for collection database (17dbb599d1). This is no longer required due to recent changes which mean the collection database will retain beatmap references even if they aren't loaded locally (see https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/18619).

I've tested this to work with some test databases I had lying around.

Closes #18730.
pr_comments: Kind of ugly but seems to work in my limited testing now.
Yeah I've also been testing (including manually simulating migration failures) and looks solid now, as far as I can tell.

issue_context.title: Potential hard crash during EF database backup
issue_context.body:
Sentry Issue: [OSU-228](https://sentry.ppy.sh/organizations/ppy/issues/2370/?referrer=github_integration)

```
System.IO.IOException: The process cannot access the file 'C:\Users\sambogangster\AppData\Roaming\osu\client.db' because it is being used by another process.
  ?, in Stream NativeStorage.GetStream(string path, FileAccess access, FileMode mode)
  ?, in Stream WrappedStorage.GetStream(string path, FileAccess access, FileMode mode)
  ?, in void DatabaseContextFactory.CreateBackup(string backupFilename)
  ?, in void OsuGameBase.load(ReadableKeyCombinationProvider keyCombinationProvider)
  ?, in InjectDependencyDelegate BackgroundDependencyLoaderAttribute.CreateActivator(Type type)+(object target, IReadOnlyDependencyContainer dc) => { } [3]
...
(56 additional frame(s) were not displayed)
```
comments:
This is a weird one.

The `GetStream` call is hitting an attempt to *create* the file as if it doesn't exist (https://github.com/ppy/osu-framework/blob/ba1385330cc501f34937e08257e586c84e35d772/osu.Framework/Platform/NativeStorage.cs#L93) but there's an `Exists` check earlier in the code which should guarantee its presence:

https://github.com/ppy/osu/blob/54a32bde44fd1fdc421a47fbd2b9cc89978d5703/osu.Game/OsuGameBase.cs#L226

The only thing I can think of is that the user somehow managed to start two instances and the other execution performed the migration?

review_comments:
I had thought `realmBlockOperations` being non-null is if `RealmAccess.CreateBackup` throws, but that can never be the case because it's surrounded by a `using` which is essentially a `try-finally` code with object being disposed in `finally` scope.

Makes me wonder if there's ever a case where `realmBlockOperations` could be non-null, but doesn't seem harmful to have anyways.
